title: Daily Challenge
tagline: the same run for everyone, today
description: One seeded run a day, the same for every player: Hop Hop and Hair Catch take turns. Beat today's board with {name}.

how.en: Same rules as the game of the day. Everyone gets the same obstacles today; Play again replays them.
how.id: Aturannya sama seperti game hari ini. Semua orang dapat rintangan yang sama hari ini; Main lagi mengulang rintangan itu.

en: A short one. Try the same run again, it is the same obstacles.
Today's run is the same for everyone. Again?
id: Pendek ya. Coba lagi, rintangannya sama kok.
Rintangan hari ini sama buat semua orang. Ulang?

en: Not bad for one run. The board is watching.
You learn the run a little more each time.
id: Lumayan buat satu kali main. Papannya ngeliatin.

en: That is a run to be proud of today.
Everyone got the same run. Few did that.
id: Ini permainan yang bisa dibanggakan hari ini.
Semua dapat rintangan yang sama. Sedikit yang sampai sejauh ini.

en: Your best on the daily. I saw it.
A new best. Same run, better you.
id: Rekor terbaikmu di tantangan harian. Aku lihat.
Rekor baru. Rintangan sama, kamunya lebih jago.

id.tagline: rintangan sama untuk semua, hari ini
id.description: Satu permainan berbenih per hari, sama untuk semua pemain: Hop Hop dan Hair Catch bergantian. Kalahkan papan hari ini bareng {name}.
